title: Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.01754v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. translated_title: Cog-VADU：一种用于视频异常检测与理解的无训练认知推理框架
translated_abstract: 视频异常检测（VAD）旨在对视频中的异常事件进行时间上的定位。现有的大多数方法依赖于特定数据集的训练和精心策划的标注，这限制了其在开放集场景中的泛化能力。近期基于大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）的零样本方法虽然减轻了这种依赖，但通常缺乏时间连续性和结构化推理能力。我们提出了Cog-VADU，这是一个完全无需训练的框架，它将视频异常检测重新表述为一个顺序认知推理任务。Cog-VADU引入了异常检测思维链提示，将大型视觉-语言模型展开为跨越视频片段的循环推理链。通过在时间上传播结构化的推理依据，模型能够维持隐式的时间记忆，从而稳健地区分复杂异常与高运动量的正常活动。为了提高可靠性，我们进一步设计了一个跨模态重排序阶段，将文本推理依据与视觉信息进行对齐。
tldr: 该论文提出了Cog-VADU，一个完全无需训练的视频异常检测与理解框架，通过异常检测思维链提示将大型视觉-语言模型展开为跨视频片段的循环推理链并维持隐式时间记忆，从而能够稳健地区分复杂异常事件与高运动量的正常活动。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates video anomaly detection as a sequential cognitive reasoning task, using Chain-of-Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting to unroll an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments with implicit temporal memory for robustly distinguishing complex anomalies from high-motion normal activities.
